title: Environmental Challenges & Management of Coastal & Arid Regions
subject: Geography
description: A mindmap outlining major environmental concerns (marine pollution, desertification, habitat fragmentation, sea-level rise, salinity intrusion) and their corresponding management strategies and relevant international conventions.

mindmap

      Climate Change
      Programs(Great Green Wall, National Afforestation Programme)

      Lessepsian Migration (Suez Canal)
      Monitoring(IUCN Framework)
    Sea-Level Rise
      Thermal Expansion (Red Sea)
      Coastal Management(Mangrove Restoration, Artificial Reefs)

      Groundwater Over-extraction (Indus River Basin)
      Mitigation(Drip-irrigation, Reclaimed Water)
